Sudden heavy downpour drums the shelter roof in rolling waves, each burst louder and cozier than the last.
Hail the size of peas bounces playfully off the eaves, skittering across the ground like scattered pearls.
Fat lazy raindrops the size of marbles fall impossibly slow, each one catching the grey light before it lands.
Rain breaks through parting clouds in warm golden god-rays, illuminating the wet grass in shifting columns.
A perfect rainbow arches impossibly bright beyond the shelter, its colors so vivid they seem painted by hand.
A double rainbow forms through the thinning rain, the second arc faint and dreamy above the first.
A single golden sunbeam pierces through dense clouds and lands directly onto the shelter roof like a spotlight.
A sun-pillar descends into the rain ahead, a vertical ribbon of amber light shimmering above the treeline.
Warm mist rises off heated stones around the shelter, curling upward in slow lazy ribbons of white.
Fog rolls in around the shelter in soft waves, muffling distant sounds and thickening the cozy silence.
Steam-curtains billow from a nearby pond as cool rain meets warm water, drifting past in ghostly sheets.
Cottony fog wraps the world beyond the shelter entirely, leaving only the immediate warmth untouched and visible.
Floating glowing dandelion seeds drift around the shelter in slow spirals, each one pulsing with soft golden light.
Fireflies dare out into the rain and form a loose halo around the shelter entrance, blinking in rhythm.
Sparkle-rain falls mixed with regular rain, each magical drop leaving a brief shimmer where it lands.
Wishing-stars descend slowly through the rainfall, trailing silver and dissolving quietly before they reach the ground.
Cherry-blossom petals carried by the rain drift into the shelter, landing softly on every available surface.
Autumn leaves swirl past the shelter in a loose amber spiral, wet and glowing against the grey sky.
Fallen rose petals tumble through the rain outside, each one catching a droplet and rolling it like a jewel.
Wet dandelion-floss drifts in slow motion past the shelter opening, each thread luminous against the dark treeline.
A giant ripple spreads across the nearest puddle in one perfect expanding ring before the rain breaks it apart.
Lily-pads on the nearby pond open wider in the rain, each one filling and tilting and spilling in sequence.
Concentric circular waves travel outward across the pond surface in hypnotic overlapping rings, endlessly repeating.
A deer pair steps silently out of the distant treeline, standing still in the rain as if posing.
A ribbon of butterflies passes through the rain in a loose migration stream, wings impossibly bright against grey clouds.
Rain intensifies to a roaring curtain, hammering the shelter roof in rhythmic surges that rise and fall like breathing.
A sudden squall pelts the eaves sideways, then stops just as abruptly, leaving perfect silence and dripping edges.
Oversized raindrops fall so slowly each one hangs visible mid-air, trembling before finally surrendering to gravity.
Parting clouds release a warm amber downpour that shifts the whole landscape gold for one breathless minute.
A triple rainbow materializes faintly beyond the trees, the third arc barely visible, gossamer and trembling.
Sunlight fractures through ragged clouds into a full spread of god-rays, each beam sweeping slowly across wet meadow.
A circular rainbow forms directly overhead, complete and unbroken, framing the grey sky like a luminous crown.
A rose-gold light pillar rises from the horizon into the clouds, steady and tall, shimmering against the rainfall.
Ground mist gathers thickly around the shelter base, swirling ankle-height like a slow breathing living thing.
Fog advances from the treeline in a single dense wall, pausing just outside the shelter as if respecting the warmth.
Thin steam-fingers rise from every rain-warmed stone nearby, weaving upward and dissolving into the cooler air above.
A low fogbank settles so completely beyond the shelter that the whole world simply ends ten feet away.
Tiny glowing orbs drift upward through the rain, hovering at eave-height before silently blinking out one by one.
Luminous blue fireflies trace slow figure-eights in the rain, leaving brief glowing trails that hang and fade.
Occasional drops in the rainfall catch an impossible inner light, flaring briefly silver before soaking into the earth.
A slow cascade of wishing-stars tilts sideways in the wind, threading between raindrops and dissolving like sugar.
A thick shower of sakura petals sweeps under the shelter eaves, spiraling upward once before settling everywhere gently.
A single enormous maple leaf cartwheels past the shelter opening in slow motion, dark red against pale mist.
Lavender petals ride the rain in loose clusters, pooling in every low hollow and glowing softly against dark soil.
Gossamer dandelion threads tangle with falling rain into slow drifting curtains, luminous and impossibly delicate.
Rain pocks the puddle surface into a constant dancing chaos, thousands of tiny crowns rising and collapsing at once.
A single enormous raindrop strikes the pond and sends one perfect ring traveling all the way to the far bank.
Rain fills the lily-pad cups to overflowing, each one tipping and righting in a slow hypnotic sequence across the pond.
A rabbit family dashes single-file past the shelter, disappearing into the fog on the far side in seconds.
Concentric rings from dozens of separate raindrops overlap across the puddle into an intricate endlessly shifting interference pattern.
